chapter_meta_description: Patriarch Subhuti accepts Ji Ning as a disciple and gives him the ultimate cheat-code training: the Dream of a Thousand Years. Ji Ning walks the entire Dao of the Sword in a single incense stick of time.
og_title: Ji Ning Receives the Dream of a Thousand Years Training
og_description: Patriarch Subhuti reveals the fate of Daoist Threelives and uses the Dream of a Thousand Years to let Ji Ning experience the complete Dao of the Sword.

lore_anchors.definition: A supreme teaching technique that allows a master to transmit a vast, experiential understanding of a Dao into a disciple's soul in a compressed dream-state, making centuries of insight feel like a single nap.
Ji Ning's new master for sword arts; a Primordial True God born from chaos who commands the Grand Dao of Spacetime and lives in the hidden Mount Innerheart.
A Water-element Ki Refining technique created by Daofather Xiaoyao, capable of allowing cultivation to the peak of the Three Realms' power hierarchy.
The hidden sanctuary of Patriarch Subhuti; a sacred mountain removed from the flow of the Three Realms, housing two Dao palaces of infinite wisdom.
The former master of the Starseizing Manor and creator of the Starseizing Hand divine ability; a peerless Fiendgod who perished in a primordial cataclysm.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What exactly is the “Dao of the Sword” in Desolate Era?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is one of the most exalted Grand Daos in the cultivation system, representing the ultimate path of offensive power and precise manipulation of sword-essence. Mastering it is the key to becoming a peerless Sword Immortal.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Subhuti make Ji Ning swear to keep their relationship a secret?
cultural_notes_faq.a: This is a classic Xianxia trope used by mysterious mentors. It protects the master from endless favor-seekers and protects the disciple from being targeted by the master's enemies, forcing the disciple to grow through their own strength.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the significance of the “heart” riddle (斜月三星) in Subhuti’s cave name?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The name forms a visual puzzle for the Chinese character 心 (heart). It reinforces the Daoist lesson that the path to ultimate understanding and the mastery of the Dao is not found externally but within one’s own heart and will.
